findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile the composition-timing claim with reconcile.py: bind_operation_runtime runs AFTER _load_snapshots (L227 vs L222) and is gated by _write_facade_enabled(); specify an unconditional pass-entry composition (before the load phase, toggle-independent) rather than 'extending that seam', or correct the 'BEFORE the load/diff phase' / 'every below-seam consumer has the value' wording.
evidence: reconcile.py reconcile_once: _load_snapshots(ctx) at L222, then bind_operation_runtime(ctx, compose_reconciler_runtime) at L227 (AFTER the load phase, immediately before run_differs)
reconcile_helpers.py bind_operation_runtime L671: 'if not _write_facade_enabled(): return' — the seam is gated behind the AC6 REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE toggle
reconcile_helpers.py L677-680: on compose/build failure a no-write pass falls back to the ambient (client=None) path rather than the composed runtime
Plan claim: composition happens 'BEFORE the load/diff phase ... so every below-seam consumer has the value on _PassContext'
findings.finding: The plan's load-bearing architectural premise — that the existing compose_reconciler_runtime / bind_operation_runtime seam can be 'extended' to compose root + typed Config ONCE at pass entry BEFORE the load/diff phase so every below-seam consumer has it on _PassContext — is contradicted by reconcile.py: that seam runs AFTER _load_snapshots and is conditional.
findings.location: Outcome section: 'extends that seam to compose root + typed Config ONCE at pass entry — BEFORE the load/diff phase (_load_snapshots/run_differs)'; AC3
scenarios: Below-seam consumers that run during _load_snapshots (e.g. binding_store.load_binding_store, fetcher, local_label_intent) would not receive a Config composed by the named seam, since that seam runs after the load phase
A no-write / dry-run pass or a pass with WRITE_FACADE disabled would skip the runtime composition entirely, leaving the below-seam consumers without the threaded Config the plan promises
findings.suggested_fix: Introduce the root+Config composition as an explicit step at the very top of reconcile_once (before _load_snapshots), storing it on _PassContext independently of bind_operation_runtime and the WRITE_FACADE toggle; keep the existing runtime/backend seam for the apply-phase transport as-is.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Separate the two backend needs in cluster 2: thread the composed typed `Config` and have the `select_backend` mapper sites (run_differs `_select_backend`, outbound_differ, inbound_differ, outbound_comments, inbound_translate, reconcile_check) re-derive the mapper via `select_backend(cfg)` (a pure config function), rather than threading the write-oriented `ReconcilerRuntime.build_backend` result (which asserts scope and is None on no-write/facade-off passes) into read-only mapping sites.
evidence: cluster-2 text: 'the composed Config (+ runtime backend for the select_backend sites) threads into the 14 reconciler modules'
runtime.py build_backend L116-152: cloud path calls assert_cloud_scope_ready(s) and constructs a real AcliClient transport — a write-scope-gated object
reconcile_helpers.bind_operation_runtime L671-682: on no-write pass (or _write_facade_enabled() False) it RETURNS without setting ctx.runtime_backend (stays None)

run_differs.py:78 `return select_backend(load_config())` is used as the field MAPPER (.outbound/.inbound) for the differs, which run on dry-run/no-write passes too; inbound_differ.py:139, outbound_differ.py:344, inbound_translate.py:355, outbound_comments.py:92 are the same mapper-only need
_backend_registry.select_backend L60-76 is a pure factory(config) — no scope assertion, no transport
findings.finding: The plan threads the write-oriented ReconcilerRuntime backend into the read-only select_backend(load_config()) mapper sites, conflating two structurally different backend needs; those differ sites need only the config-derived .inbound/.outbound/.sanitizer mapper on every pass, whereas build_backend asserts provider scope readiness and is left None on no-write / write-facade-disabled passes.
findings.location: The cut, by cluster → cluster 2 — load_config (17): '(+ runtime backend for the select_backend sites)'
scenarios: A dry-run / reconcile-check pass with no Jira scope configured: today select_backend(load_config()) yields a mapper fine; threading the runtime backend would trip assert_cloud_scope_ready or hand the differ None
REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE off (AC6 rollback): bind_operation_runtime returns early, so any differ reading the threaded runtime_backend gets None
findings.suggested_fix: In cluster 2, thread only the composed `Config`; at each `select_backend(load_config())` site replace the ambient `load_config()` with the threaded `cfg` (`select_backend(cfg)`), leaving the write-runtime backend threading (ctx.runtime_backend) exclusively for the apply phase as bind_operation_runtime already scopes it.
